# Nadeuri (나들이)

> Real-time accessibility facility monitoring for Seoul Metro

## About

Nadeuri is a public service that monitors real-time operating status of accessibility facilities across Seoul Metro stations. It tracks 9 types of accessibility facilities (elevators, escalators, moving walks, wheelchair lifts, safety boards, disabled restrooms, sign language phones, wheelchair chargers, and mobility helpers) across 300+ stations on lines 1-9 and S-line.

## Key Pages

- Home (Korean): https://nadeuri.today/ko/
- Home (English): https://nadeuri.today/en/
- Home (Japanese): https://nadeuri.today/ja/
- Home (Chinese): https://nadeuri.today/zh/
- Current Faults: https://nadeuri.today/ko/faults/
- About / Data Sources: https://nadeuri.today/ko/about/
- Station pages: https://nadeuri.today/ko/station/{station_code}/

## Data Source

All facility data is collected from the Seoul Open Data Plaza (서울 열린 데이터 광장) official API.
Data is updated automatically every 90 minutes via scheduled collection.

## Facility Types Monitored

### Real-time (status tracked)
- Elevators (엘리베이터)
- Escalators (에스컬레이터)
- Moving walks (무빙워크)
- Wheelchair lifts (휠체어리프트)
- Safety boards (안전발판)

### Static (availability tracked)
- Disabled restrooms (장애인화장실)
- Sign language video phones (수어영상전화기)
- Wheelchair chargers (휠체어급속충전기)
- Mobility helpers (교통약자도우미)

## Facility Statuses

- OPERATING: Normal operation
- FAULT: Out of service
- MAINTENANCE: Under maintenance
- UNKNOWN: Status unavailable

## Languages

Korean (primary), English, Japanese, Chinese (Simplified)
